_note: The regression set for the classifier: every item of the four channels the survey of 2026-09-18 hand-classified, labelled here by post id so that the text itself stays exactly as the captured preview page holds it. Four labels: pack-grade (a fact a pack would want), perishable (a true tariff or offer that stops being true), weak (real, but no rule anyone can act on) and excluded. Only pack-grade and perishable are admitted; weak and excluded are not.
_windows: Fana 19 posts and ethio telecom 12 posts from 16-18 September, NBE all 16 over 32 days, Customs all 8 over 14 months. The survey counted 54 items; this set holds 55, because ethio telecom posted once more between the survey and the capture.
